Create a finished hand-painted traditional2D Sengoku beat-em-up sprite animation atlas with TRUE transparent alpha. Use supplied approved faction reference ONLY for character identities, simple historical armor, cloth, helmets, sash colors and flag. Do not turn ordinary footsoldiers into luxurious ornate generals. Sharp ink outline and readable anatomy, natural gray steel no glow. EXACTLY4COLUMNS x8ROWS=32 separately drawn fullbody chronological poses. PORTRAIT canvas1024x2048 requested; evenly spaced invisible cells. Everycomplete figure AND weapon/flag fit within its own cell at consistent percharacterbody scale; leave25px fully transparent gap to ALL neighbors. Longspears may be drawn diagonally or foreshortened carefully but never crop or touch neighboringcell. No background, floor, shadows, VFX, lightingglow, grid, labels, text. Characters faceRIGHT, side/slightthreequarter arcade view. Eachrow4genuine sequential poses: ready, windup, strike/release, recover. WALK rows4different legcycle poses. Preserve fullweapon andbody; no duplicates, blankcells or overlappingfigures. Fixedsolesbaseline eachrow. NO added coatsofarmor, modernweapons or inventedcrest. 
REFERENCE SUBJECTS: rows0-3 use FIRST LEFTMOST ordinary spear footsoldier. rows4-7 use THIRD flagbearer. Preserve their OWN simple cuirass/cloths/helmet/sash fromreference. Onlythese TWO characters, ignoreother3referencepeople. Row0 footsoldier WALK4poses. Row1 spear straight THRUST4poses: ready diagonal, pullback, extendstraightRIGHT, withdraw. Row2 spear LOW SWEEP4poses: lowerstance, coil, lowwidehorizontalright sweep, recover. Row3 SPEAR BUTT STRIKE4poses: reversegripwindup, butt lifts, bluntwoodenENDstrikesright, recover; NOT sword. Row4 flagbearer WALK4poses holding large clothstandardpole with originalapproved flagdesign. Row5 flagpole forward POKE4poses. Row6 low sweeping flagpole4poses. Row7 raise standard high then downward POLE SLAM4poses. Flagcloth follows pole and remains fullyvisible with clear space. Exactly32fullbody separateframes and correct character switch afterfirst16.
